name: Workflow Builder
summary: A vertical flow canvas of trigger, action and condition steps joined by lines, with an add-step button between nodes and a settings form for the selected step.
useWhen: An editor where people chain triggers, actions and conditions into an automation
A low-code setup screen where each step needs a name, a kind and a detail
avoidWhen: Branching graphs with many parallel paths or drag-to-connect wiring, which need a real node-graph library
Read-only pipelines or stage boards, where planning/kanban or business/pipeline-01 fits better
